title: Baseline expense difficulty predicts a later material-pressure gradient without a clean confidence shift
source_unit: April-to-June 2025 Census HTOPS public-use respondent intersection linked by SCRAMID; selected linked sample, not an attrition-adjusted national panel

observations.period: April 15–29 to June 16–25, 2025; baseline expense difficulty versus no difficulty

denominator.unit: exact SCRAMID-linked respondents; outcome-specific valid counts range from 2,574 to 3,961

observations.method: Exact SCRAMID intersection of April and June HTOPS public-use files; baseline PWEIGHT and 80 April replicate weights retained for the descriptive cross-lagged cells.
observations.uncertainty: April weights and replicate weights are not documented as attrition-adjusted longitudinal weights. Expense difficulty is self-reported, follow-up outcomes are descriptive, item universes differ, and no causal effect or national transition estimate is claimed.
observations.subgroup: Linked respondents classified by April usual-expense difficulty; later June food, energy, job-loss, and Congress-confidence outcomes use their own valid universes.
observations.counterinterpretation: Baseline expense difficulty may proxy prior income, health, housing, debt, family, or other shocks. Later hardship can reflect intervening events, and the near-equal Congress-confidence shares do not identify attribution, trust change, or political action.

related_sources.claim: Machine-readable audit preserves linked IDs, measures, standard errors, valid counts, and raw-file hashes.
Linkage, weight, retention, and interpretation boundaries are documented.

boundary: This record establishes a same-respondent cross-lagged descriptive association between April expense difficulty and selected June material and institutional outcomes. It does not establish a dated bill, actor, causality, attrition-adjusted population transition, remedy, recovery, trust change, political action, switching, or exit.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: Retained HTOPS cross-lagged audit and its April/June public-use file hashes; no new raw files downloaded in this pass
